replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Translation to English:

My minecraft crashed and you thought I intentionally combat logged, and you banned me. It's been more than a year since I started playing here, why would I do it on propose? You banned me unfairly, so please appeal it when you can, thanks.

replies.body: Pido perdón por los combat logging lo hice de enojado, prometo que no volverá a suceder, es la última vez. Aprendí mi lección.

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
You have combat logged 4 times now. You will not be unbanned. You can wait out for a few months and send in another and it may be considered. This appeal is denied.

Regards,
Straightened
Avicus Network Administrator
